traits.note: Abrams's Illustrated Flora of the Pacific States, volume 3 (1951), read in full: sepals 5, imbricated, persistent; corolla sympetalous, tubular, 5-lobed; stamens 10 to 15 on the base of the corolla tube; ovary imperfectly 3-celled. SEINet's genus text (as quoted in search results; the page itself was not read): pistil 3-carpelled, ovary superior.
